name: Macedonian
sources: Институт за македонски јазик 2017, Правопис на македонскиот јазик, 2nd ed., ch. II, p. 25: the stress "паѓа на третиот слог од крајот" in inherited and adapted vocabulary; exceptions are verbs in -ира and words still in adaptation

р acts as a vowel when found between two consonants, e.g. црква (Wikipedia, Macedonian language); stress falls on the third from last syllable in words with three or more syllables, on the first or only syllable in other words
